signature.name: Minneapolis Institute of Art
signature.detail: One of the finest encyclopedic art museums in the country, with a vast collection spanning centuries and cultures. Admission is free, so it is an easy must-see; go on a weekday morning to avoid crowds.

signature.name: Minneapolis Sculpture Garden
signature.detail: Home to the iconic Spoonbridge and Cherry, this garden is a beloved photo spot and a relaxing green space. Visit in the late afternoon for softer light; it is free and open daily.

signature.name: Stone Arch Bridge
signature.detail: A historic stone bridge offering stunning views of the Mississippi River and the city skyline. Walk or bike across at sunset for the best photos; it is free and accessible from downtown.

signature.name: Minnehaha Falls
signature.detail: A beautiful 53-foot waterfall in a city park, perfect for a nature escape without leaving Minneapolis. Go after rain for a stronger flow; the park is free and has walking trails.

signature.name: Mall of America
signature.detail: The largest shopping mall in the US, featuring an amusement park, aquarium, and hundreds of stores. It is a must-see for entertainment; arrive early on weekends to avoid crowds.

signature.name: Walker Art Center
signature.detail: A contemporary art museum known for its innovative exhibitions and adjacent sculpture garden. Check for free admission days; the museum is a short walk from the Sculpture Garden.

signature.name: Target Field
signature.detail: A modern baseball stadium in downtown Minneapolis, home to the Minnesota Twins. Catch a game for the lively atmosphere; tickets are affordable and the stadium is easily reached by light rail.

signature.name: University of Minnesota Twin Cities
signature.detail: A major public university with a vibrant campus and cultural events. Explore the Weisman Art Museum and stroll the campus; it is free to visit and well-connected by transit.

transport: Light rail $2-3 a ride; day pass $6
